_note: Starting values from DLMM-Auto-Entry-Spec v1 (133 closed positions, Oct 25 - Nov 4 2026). Change only after re-testing on unseen tokens (spec section 7).

gates._maxPositionPctOfTvl: off (owner, 2026-11-04); set a number like 3 to gate size vs TVL again

position._ladder: RH ladder: equal-width slices from the price down to rangeBottomPct, SOL split 1:2:...:n (deepest slice biggest), Spot inside each

signal._note: Entry ping: pool passes the v1 gates AND sits inside the benchmark wallet's habitat (bin steps it made SOL in + p10-p90 of pool age, mcap, fees 1h/24h at its entries). A similarity check on top of the gates, not a predictor (spec section 2).

bandOverrides._note: Owner's fixed layer-2 bands (2026-11-04), used instead of the benchmark's p10-p90 for these dims; null = no limit. Bin step + pool age still come from the benchmark.

exits._note: Spec section 4: every fixed TP / SL / trailing / time limit lost SOL vs. holding (TP +1/+2/+5/+10% = -7.16/-7.57/-4.37/-1.06 SOL). They stay null unless you turn them on.
